decisions.reason: Because this certified HVAC plate heat exchanger line remains very close to the firm's core heat-exchanger engineering, service learning, and in-house R&D base, management would more likely refine and support it than withdraw it.

The marine box cooler system builds directly on established marine cooling know-how and already showed strong market acceptance, so absorptive capacity and installed-base advantages strongly favor retention.

This marine cooling unit fits the firm's existing marine applications and service capabilities, giving management enough related knowledge to continue improving it despite limited later public evidence.

The compact oil cooler is still closely related to the firm's exchanger portfolio and can be improved through its engineering and field-service feedback, though the thinner observed market evidence makes it somewhat more at risk than the strongest products.
